meaning: downloading and validating this data does NOT contaminate 2010-2014. What would consume it is joining revenue to FUTURE RETURNS. Do not do that until the persistence definition is written into a spec and the code is frozen.

completeness_guard.rule: a month below 75% of the median row count is re-fetched once
completeness_guard.why: the fetcher can return PARTIAL data without raising. 2014-01 and 2014-03 first came back with 633/634 rows against a ~1450 neighbour median, with no exception.

validation.negative_revenue_note: 119 rows across 35 securities, concentrated in financial holding companies in December (2881/2882/2887/2892). Year-end adjustments; real data.

CRITICAL_FINDING_ifrs_break_2013.what: raw revenue LEVELS have a structural break at 2013: Taiwan moved monthly revenue reporting from parent-only to CONSOLIDATED under IFRS.
CRITICAL_FINDING_ifrs_break_2013.source_yoy_is_safe: the source-provided yoy_pct shows no anomaly in 2013 (median +1.12%, comparable to 2011 +0.14% and 2012 -1.30%) because MOPS restates the prior-year figure on the same basis.
CRITICAL_FINDING_ifrs_break_2013.RULE: DO NOT compute year-over-year growth from raw revenue levels across the 2012/2013 boundary. Use the source-provided yoy_pct. Any persistence measure built from revenue LEVELS or from chained MoM across 2013 is broken.
